title: Garden Guardian
note: Each script's output is compared line by line to the subject example, the functions are imported and called directly (return value + raised exception), and the source is checked for the authorized builtins and type hints.

stdout.expected:
=== Garden Temperature ===
Input data is '25'
Temperature is now 25°C
Input data is 'abc'
Caught input_temperature error: invalid literal for int() with base 10: 'abc'
All tests completed - program didn't crash!

tests.name: input_temperature() returns an int / raises
code: assert type(m.input_temperature('25')) is int, 'must return an int'
assert isinstance(err, ValueError), "'abc' must raise ValueError, got %r" % err

tests.name: 0 and 40 are accepted, 41 / -1 / 'abc' raise
code: assert err is not None, '%r must raise' % bad

items: Caught ValueError: invalid literal for int() with base 10: 'abc'

items.re: Caught FileNotFoundError: \[Errno 2\] No such file or directory: '.+'

items: Caught TypeError: can only concatenate str (not "int") to str

tests.name: garden_operations(n) raises the right error
code: assert type(err) is kind, 'operation %d: expected %s, got %r' % (n, kind.__name__, err)
assert err is None, 'operation %d must not raise, got %r' % (n, err)

tests.name: class tree + default messages
code: assert issubclass(m.PlantError, m.GardenError), 'PlantError must inherit GardenError'
assert issubclass(m.WaterError, m.GardenError), 'WaterError must inherit GardenError'
assert str(cls()), '%s() has no default message' % cls.__name__
assert str(m.PlantError('x')) == 'x', 'a given message must replace the default one'
